summary: 建物或構件之轉角部位。

summary: 震後結構持續發出異音可能反映構件仍在變形
description: 地震後建築物在回歸原位過程中可能發出輕微聲響，屬正常現象。但持續、大聲且伴隨裂縫擴大或粉塵掉落的異常聲響，往往代表構件仍在變形或處於不穩定狀態，應立即撤離並請技師評估。

source_nodes.reason: 結構異常聲響: post-quake observation concept; no canonical equivalent.

summary: 本系統依CV模型辨識照片中的損傷類別

source_nodes.reason: 影像辨識: system feature describing the upstream CV model; no canonical equivalent.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 AUX_AI_IMAGE_RECOGNITION.

summary: 建築地下室位置的柱
description: 地下室柱承受上方所有樓層累積荷載，是垂直承重關鍵構件。地下停車場柱受損可能危及上方多個樓層。

source_nodes.reason: 地下室柱: a specific column-type by location (basement). Narrower than the generic 柱 (E_term_006).

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: kept_separate_with_link from QA T5 AUX_BASEMENT_COLUMN; narrower_than E_term_006 (柱) — basement-specific column.

summary: 在基礎與上部結構間設隔震墊降低地震輸入
description: 隔震建築於基礎與上部結構間設置鉛心橡膠墊或滑動支承，延長建築週期並降低地震加速度傳遞，使上部結構受力顯著減少。

source_nodes.reason: 隔震建築 (a building TYPE that uses base isolation) vs DM_term_153 隔震 (the design METHOD). Different conceptual layers.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: kept_separate_with_link from QA T5 AUX_BASE_ISOLATION; uses_method DM_term_153 (隔震).

summary: 既有裂縫長度或寬度持續增加
description: 裂縫擴展為既有裂縫在持續荷載、溫度循環、鋼筋鏽蝕或基礎沉陷下持續發展，是結構損傷惡化的重要警訊。

source_nodes.reason: 裂縫擴展 (crack-specific propagation/widening) is narrower than AUX_DAMAGE_PROGRESSION (general damage progression including spalling, rebar exposure, etc.).

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: kept_separate_with_link from QA T5 AUX_CRACK_PROPAGATION; narrower_than AUX_DAMAGE_PROGRESSION (損傷惡化).

summary: 耐震設計規範規定建築應能承受的地表加速度水準
description: 耐震設計規範依據各地區地震危害度規定設計用地表加速度。建築結構設計需確保其在此設計加速度下構件不致破壞、人員可安全避難。當實際地震超過設計水準時，即使新建築仍可能損傷。

source_nodes.reason: 設計地表加速度 (regulatory design value, prescribed by code) vs SC_term_125 地表加速度峰值 (PGA — actual measured peak in an earthquake). Different conceptual layers: design-side vs measurement-side.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: kept_separate_with_link from QA T5 AUX_DESIGN_GROUND_ACCEL; design_value_of SC_term_125 (地表加速度峰值 — actual PGA).

summary: 地震時的標準避難動作
description: 趴下掩護穩住為國際公認地震避難動作：低伏身體、躲入堅固桌下並穩握桌腳，避免被掉落物砸傷與保持身體穩定。

source_nodes.reason: 趴下掩護穩住: the standardized in-quake action sequence (drop, cover, hold-on); no canonical equivalent.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 AUX_DROP_COVER_HOLD.

summary: 提升構件韌性的配筋與接頭設計細部規定
description: 韌性配筋細部包含柱箍筋加密、梁柱接頭剪力鋼筋、主筋搭接位置與長度等規定，使構件在地震超載時能以延性方式吸收能量而非脆性破壞。921地震後耐震規範大幅強化此類細部要求。

source_nodes.reason: 韌性配筋細部 (ductile detailing — specific reinforcement-detail rules) is a SPECIFIC ASPECT of DM_term_1017 韌性設計 (overall ductile design). Different granularity.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: kept_separate_with_link from QA T5 AUX_DUCTILE_DETAILING; specific_aspect_of DM_term_1017 (韌性設計).

summary: 利用P波先到原理提供搖晃前秒級警示
description: 地震預警利用P波傳播較快之特性，在S波抵達前數秒至數十秒發布警報，使民眾有時間採取避難動作。

source_nodes.reason: 地震預警 (the EEW concept). DIFFERENT from SC_term_1293 地震速報 (post-event bulletin) — the QA alias 地震速報 is a colloquial conflation that should NOT be propagated as deterministic mapping. Linked to AUX_INST_term_489 地震預警系統 (the implementing system).

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: kept_separate_with_link from QA T5 AUX_EARTHQUAKE_EARLY_WARNING; realized_by AUX_INST_term_489 (地震預警系統 — the implementing system).
warnings: alias_conflict: 地震速報 colloquially conflates with 地震預警 but strictly means post-event bulletin (SC_term_1293)

summary: 建築升降設備，地震時可能因軌道變形或纜線鬆脫而需專業檢查
description: 現代電梯多配備地震感知器，於強震時自動停靠最近樓層。地震可能造成電梯軌道變形、纜線鬆脫或機械故障，未經電梯維護公司檢查前不應貿然使用。地震後撤離應走樓梯。

source_nodes.reason: 電梯: building system — non-structural building component; no canonical equivalent.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 AUX_ELEVATOR.

summary: 持照結構技師之正式評估文件
description: 結構技師鑑定報告為現場勘查、量測與分析後出具之正式文件，具法律效力，可作為理賠、危老申請、補強依據。

source_nodes.reason: 結構技師鑑定報告: a formal document/output produced by a licensed engineer; distinct from the inspection ACTION (ACT_ENGINEER_INSPECTION) and the inspection METHOD (AUX_PROFESSIONAL_EVAL).

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 AUX_ENGINEER_INSPECTION_REPORT.

summary: 震災緊急避難所需物資集合
description: 避難包應含飲水、急救包、手電筒、口哨、保暖衣物、現金、證件影本、緊急聯絡資訊等，建議家庭備妥並放置於易取處。

source_nodes.reason: 避難包: pre-quake preparedness item; no canonical equivalent.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 AUX_EVAC_BAG.

summary: 樓地板出現可察覺之傾斜
description: 地板傾斜為基礎不均勻沉陷或結構整體傾斜的明顯徵兆，需立即請技師檢查。

source_nodes.reason: 地板傾斜: floor/slab-level tilt — narrower than AUX_TILT (any element). Distinct from T_term_280 (whole-building tilt) and AUX_BUILDING_TILT (also building-level).

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: kept_separate_with_link from QA T5 AUX_FLOOR_TILT; narrower_than AUX_TILT (傾斜 — generic) — floor/slab-specific.

summary: 瓦斯管線損壞造成氣體外洩
description: 地震後管線可能位移破裂，造成瓦斯洩漏。發現異味應立即關閉總開關、開窗通風並避免火源。

source_nodes.reason: 瓦斯洩漏: post-quake utility hazard; no canonical equivalent.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 AUX_GAS_LEAKAGE.

summary: 震後地表局部隆起、塌陷或錯位現象
description: 地面隆起或下陷可能由斷層錯動、土壤液化、地下管線破裂後土砂流失等原因造成。明顯的地面變形會直接影響鄰近建築的地基穩定性，應請技師檢視地基安全。

source_nodes.reason: 地面隆起或下陷 (broader: ground deformation including uplift OR subsidence) vs T_term_450 地盤隆起 (specifically uplift). The QA concept is broader.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: kept_separate_with_link from QA T5 AUX_GROUND_DEFORMATION; broader_than T_term_450 (地盤隆起 — uplift only).

summary: 天花板、壁紙、磁磚等裝飾層常遮蔽結構構件的真實損傷
description: 建築內外的裝潢面材（天花板、壁紙、造型牆、外牆磁磚等）常使柱、梁、剪力牆等承重構件的裂縫與剝落不易直接觀察。地震後若僅依外觀判斷可能低估實際損傷，應移開可拆式裝潢檢查關鍵構件。

source_nodes.reason: 室內裝潢遮蔽: inspection obstacle concept (decor hides damage); no canonical equivalent.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 AUX_INTERIOR_DECORATION.

summary: 建築隔震系統常用裝置，由鉛心與多層橡膠組成，吸收地震能量
description: 鉛心橡膠隔震墊（LRB）安裝於建築基礎與上部結構之間，利用鉛心提供阻尼、橡膠提供水平變形能力，可大幅降低傳遞至上部結構的地震加速度。為現代隔震建築最常見的裝置之一。

source_nodes.reason: 鉛心橡膠隔震墊 (LRB — lead-rubber bearing, with lead core) is a SPECIFIC TYPE of DM_term_304 橡膠隔震墊 (generic rubber bearing). LRB has distinct mechanical behaviour due to lead-core damping.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: kept_separate_with_link from QA T5 AUX_LEAD_RUBBER_BEARING; narrower_than DM_term_304 (橡膠隔震墊 — generic rubber bearing).

description: 輕鋼架天花板為非結構懸吊系統，地震時可能掉落但通常不代表結構損傷。

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 AUX_LIGHT_GAUGE_CEILING.

summary: 顯示各地區液化潛勢分級之圖資

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 AUX_LIQUEFACTION_POTENTIAL_MAP.

summary: 承受彎矩與軸力的主要鋼筋
description: 主筋為構件中沿主要受力方向配置之鋼筋，承擔彎矩產生之拉、壓力與軸力。

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: kept_separate_with_link from QA T5 AUX_MAIN_REBAR; narrower_than M_term_268 (鋼筋 — generic rebar).

summary: 以磚與砂漿砌築的承重結構
description: 磚造建築主要由黏土磚與砂漿砌築而成，抗壓較高但抗拉與抗剪較弱，無圍束時抗震性能差。

source_nodes.reason: 磚造 (a BUILDING TYPE built from masonry) vs M_term_266 磚砌體 (the MATERIAL itself). Different conceptual layers.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: kept_separate_with_link from QA T5 AUX_MASONRY; made_of M_term_266 (磚砌體 — the masonry material).

summary: 磚牆中黏結磚塊的水泥砂漿層，為磚造結構的天然弱面
description: 磚造或加強磚造結構中，磚塊間以水泥砂漿黏結。砂漿的抗拉與抗剪強度遠低於磚體本身，地震時剪力與張力會優先沿灰縫破壞，是磚造建築脆性破壞的主要路徑。

source_nodes.reason: 砂漿灰縫 (the JOINT in masonry walls — a structural location/feature, the canonical weak plane) vs M_term_267 砂漿 (the MATERIAL). Different layers; the joint USES the material.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: kept_separate_with_link from QA T5 AUX_MORTAR_JOINT; uses_material M_term_267 (砂漿).

summary: 鄰近施工或拆除造成既有建築損傷之鑑定
description: 鄰損鑑定為鄰近施工、開挖或拆除前後對既有建築進行紀錄比較之專業鑑定，作為損害賠償依據。

source_nodes.reason: 鄰損鑑定: formal pre/post-construction adjacency inspection procedure; no canonical equivalent.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 AUX_NEIGHBOR_DAMAGE_INSPECTION.

summary: 鄰接建築拆除造成連帶損傷
description: 與既有房屋共用牆或緊鄰之鄰房拆除可能改變側向支撐與防水條件，造成既有房屋裂縫或滲水。

source_nodes.reason: 鄰房拆除: neighboring-building demolition as a damage cause; no canonical equivalent.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 AUX_NEIGHBOR_DEMOLITION.

summary: 依新版規範新建之建築
description: 新建築依現行耐震規範與品質規範設計施工，理論上具備較高抗震能力，但實際耐震性能仍受施工品質與超出設計地震影響。

source_nodes.reason: 新建築: building-age classification (post current-code building); paired with AUX_OLD_BUILDING.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 AUX_NEW_BUILDING.

summary: 依舊版規範建造或長期使用後之建築
description: 老建築通常指依舊版耐震規範設計或屋齡超過30年之建築，由於規範差異與材料劣化，地震受損風險顯著高於新建築。

source_nodes.reason: 老建築: building-age classification (built under older codes / long in use); paired with AUX_NEW_BUILDING.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 AUX_OLD_BUILDING.

summary: 依危老條例對危險老舊建築進行拆除重建之機制
description: 依《都市危險及老舊建築物加速重建條例》，符合條件之危險建築或屋齡30年以上且耐震不足之建築可申請重建並獲得容積與稅賦獎勵。

source_nodes.reason: 危老重建 is a SPECIFIC Taiwan policy programme (危險及老舊建築物加速重建條例) with formal eligibility criteria. AUX_REPAIR_term_798 拆除重建 is the generic demolish-rebuild action. The canonical already has 危老重建 listed as alias, but the programme-specific concept warrants its own node.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: kept_separate_with_link from QA T5 AUX_OLD_BUILDING_REBUILD; narrower_than AUX_REPAIR_term_798 (拆除重建 — generic demolish-rebuild).

summary: 牆體上的門窗洞口，使截面不連續並造成角隅應力集中

source_nodes.reason: 開口（門窗洞口）: geometric feature on walls; no canonical equivalent. Linked downstream by CAUSE_OPENING_NEAR (stress concentration at openings).

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 AUX_OPENING.

summary: 影響上游影像辨識準確度的照片條件（光線、角度、比例尺）
description: 使用者上傳的照片品質直接影響AI影像辨識的準確度。建議拍攝損傷全貌、確保光線充足、採用正面角度、放置比例尺物件以利尺寸判讀，並從多角度拍攝以取得完整資訊。

source_nodes.reason: 拍攝照片品質: system-usage concept (upstream of AI image recognition); no canonical equivalent.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 AUX_PHOTO_QUALITY.

summary: 台灣位於歐亞板塊與菲律賓海板塊交界，地震頻繁的構造背景
description: 台灣島位於歐亞板塊東緣與菲律賓海板塊碰撞帶上，屬環太平洋地震帶的一部分，板塊每年以數公分速率擠壓累積能量並透過地震釋放。此構造背景使全島皆有地震風險，東部因正面碰撞活動最頻繁。

source_nodes.reason: 板塊交界帶: tectonic-context concept; no canonical equivalent.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 AUX_PLATE_BOUNDARY.

summary: 本系統對使用者上傳資料的處理規範

source_nodes.reason: 隱私政策: system disclosure concept; no canonical equivalent.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 AUX_PRIVACY_POLICY.

summary: 震後創傷後壓力之心理支持資源
description: 震後出現持續焦慮、失眠、發抖、過度警覺等反應為常見災後壓力反應，可尋求心理諮商、衛生局或張老師等專線協助。

source_nodes.reason: 災後心理諮商: post-disaster mental-health resource; no canonical equivalent.

source_nodes.reason: 鋼筋鈍化膜: chemistry / micro-phenomenon explaining how concrete protects rebar; no canonical equivalent. Loss of passivation is the upstream of CAUSE_REBAR_CORROSION.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 AUX_REBAR_PASSIVATION.

summary: 系統判斷僅供初步參考，不具法律效力
description: 本系統提供之損傷判斷與費用估算僅供參考，不取代結構技師現場勘查、亦不具法律效力。重要決策應請持照技師出具正式鑑定報告。

source_nodes.reason: 參考性質: system-disclaimer concept; no canonical equivalent.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 AUX_REFERENCE_ONLY.

summary: 政府對中小學老舊校舍系統性辦理的耐震評估與補強計畫
description: 台灣自921後針對中小學老舊校舍辦理的全國性耐震評估與補強計畫，多採用RC翼牆、剪力牆增設或鋼框架補強等工法，使校舍可承受設計地震力，是學校建築震後相對安全的重要原因。

source_nodes.reason: 校舍耐震補強: a SPECIFIC nation-wide programme for K-12 school buildings (post-921). Specific instance of generic AUX_REPAIR_term_137 耐震補強.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: kept_separate_with_link from QA T5 AUX_SCHOOL_RETROFIT; specific_programme_of AUX_REPAIR_term_137 (耐震補強) — Taiwan post-921 school retrofit programme.

summary: 混凝土使用未洗淨海砂的建築
description: 海砂屋為混凝土骨材使用未洗淨海砂之建築，砂中氯離子持續破壞鋼筋鈍化膜，造成大規模鋼筋鏽蝕、保護層剝落與鋼筋裸露。

source_nodes.reason: 海砂屋 is a BUILDING TYPE (a building constructed with chloride-contaminated aggregate) — distinct from CAUSE_term_119 氯離子侵蝕 (the chemical/cause phenomenon). Note: canonical CAUSE_term_119 already lists 海砂屋 as alias colloquially; that alias is conceptually a building rather than the cause. Flag for alias-index review.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: kept_separate_with_link from QA T5 AUX_SEA_SAND_BUILDING; affected_by CAUSE_term_119 (氯離子侵蝕 — the chloride-attack mechanism).
warnings: alias_conflict: 海砂屋 currently listed as alias of CAUSE_term_119 but strictly is a building_type; alias-index phase should disambiguate

summary: 建築設計地震力與重量之比例係數
description: 耐震係數為設計地震力與建築重量之比，反映建築抗震能力。台灣依分區、地盤、用途、結構系統等決定。921後設計係數普遍提高。

source_nodes.reason: 耐震係數 (a dimensionless ratio = design force / building weight) is conceptually distinct from PROP_term_1271 設計地震力 (the actual force in N or kN). One is a coefficient; the other is a force quantity. They are related as ratio↔ scaled force.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: kept_separate_with_link from QA T5 AUX_SEISMIC_COEFFICIENT; ratio_basis_of PROP_term_1271 (設計地震力).

summary: 未經評估的結構改動造成耐震能力下降
description: 未經結構技師評估即擅自拆除剪力牆、隔間牆、改梁或柱，將改變受力分布與剛度，降低建築耐震能力。

source_nodes.reason: 結構改動: unauthorized structural modification (wall removal, beam/column changes) as a cause. NOTE: QA node_id AUX_SHEAR_WALL_REGISTRY is misnamed — display 結構改動 is generic structural modification, not a registry. Renamed canonical id to AUX_STRUCTURAL_MODIFICATION for clarity.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 AUX_SHEAR_WALL_REGISTRY.
warnings: id_misnomer: QA node_id AUX_SHEAR_WALL_REGISTRY does not match display 結構改動; renamed to AUX_STRUCTURAL_MODIFICATION

summary: 高樓頂樓搖晃幅度顯著大於底層
description: 高樓頂樓搖晃幅度因動力放大效應顯著大於底層，但底層柱所承受剪力與軸力最大，兩者風險不同。

source_nodes.reason: 頂樓放大效應: dynamic-amplification phenomenon at upper stories; no canonical equivalent.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 AUX_TOP_FLOOR_AMPLIFICATION.

summary: 地震後給水管線損壞
description: 地震後給水管線可能破損漏水，應關閉總水閥並待檢查確認後再供水，以免因滲水加速鋼筋鏽蝕。

source_nodes.reason: 水管破裂: post-quake utility hazard; no canonical equivalent.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 AUX_WATER_PIPE_BREAK.

summary: 主震後餘震使既有損傷擴大或新增損傷
description: 餘震為主震後地殼能量釋放繼續產生的較小地震。已受主震損傷的建築其餘力承載已下降，餘震可能使裂縫擴大、結構失效。

source_nodes.reason: 餘震累積損傷 is the cumulative-damage PHENOMENON over multiple aftershocks, distinct from SC_term_127 餘震 which is the seismic event type itself.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: kept_separate_with_link from QA T5 CAUSE_AFTERSHOCK_ACCUMULATION; caused_by SC_term_127 (餘震 — aftershock events).

summary: 構件承受垂直荷重超過設計容許值
description: 柱或牆等垂直承重構件承受的軸向壓力超過混凝土抗壓強度時，混凝土被壓碎沿軸向開裂，常因增建、違建或改變使用用途造成。

source_nodes.reason: 軸向壓力過大 (specifically axial compression overload) is narrower than CAUSE_OVERLOAD 超載 (any kind of overload).

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: kept_separate_with_link from QA T5 CAUSE_AXIAL_OVERLOAD; narrower_than CAUSE_OVERLOAD (超載 — generic overload).

summary: 鄰近工地打樁、開挖等振動傳至既有建築造成損傷
description: 鄰近施工的打樁、爆破、重型機具操作等振動透過地層傳至鄰房，可造成既有建築裂縫擴大或新生細小裂縫，屬鄰損鑑定範疇。

source_nodes.reason: 鄰近施工震動: vibration from adjacent construction as a damage cause; no canonical equivalent.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 CAUSE_CONSTRUCTION_VIBRATION.

summary: 地震等反覆方向變化的動態載重
description: 反覆載重指方向反覆改變的動態荷載，地震時建築承受兩個方向的水平剪力即屬此類。反覆剪力為X形裂縫的直接成因。

source_nodes.reason: 反覆載重 (cyclic loading — the LOADING REGIME) is the upstream cause of CAUSE_term_284 疲勞 (fatigue — the resulting MECHANISM). Loading cause vs failure mechanism are different conceptual layers.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: kept_separate_with_link from QA T5 CAUSE_CYCLIC_LOAD; underlying_mechanism_of CAUSE_term_284 (疲勞 — fatigue mechanism).

summary: 實際地震強度超過建築之設計地震強度
description: 建築依設計地震力進行設計，當實際地震超過設計值時，新建築也可能受損，但依規範設計之建築仍應具備不倒塌之韌性目標。

source_nodes.reason: 超過設計地震: actual seismic intensity exceeding the design level; no canonical equivalent.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 CAUSE_DESIGN_EARTHQUAKE_EXCEEDED.

summary: 綜合環境作用：溫度、濕度、化學等
description: 環境因素為溫度、濕度、化學氣體、海風等作用之綜合代名詞，常為非結構性裂縫的成因之一。

source_nodes.reason: 環境因素: umbrella cause covering temperature, humidity, chemical exposure etc.; no canonical equivalent at this generality.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 CAUSE_ENV_FACTOR.

summary: 構件承受的彎矩超過抗彎強度
description: 彎矩產生於梁柱受側向力時，使構件一側受拉、另一側受壓。當受拉側拉應力超過混凝土抗拉強度，會產生與軸線垂直的裂縫。

source_nodes.reason: 彎矩過大 (excessive moment — overload condition / cause) is conceptually distinct from TERM_term_015 彎矩 (the moment quantity itself).

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: kept_separate_with_link from QA T5 CAUSE_FLEXURAL_MOMENT; overload_of TERM_term_015 (彎矩).

summary: 地基條件不良造成建築受損
description: 地基問題泛指承載力不足、地下空洞、回填不實、軟弱層、地下水變化等地工因素，常造成不均勻沉陷與相關裂縫。

source_nodes.reason: 地基問題: umbrella cause for geotechnical issues (capacity, voids, fill, soft layers, water-table changes); no canonical equivalent.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 CAUSE_GROUND_PROBLEM.

summary: 未經結構評估的增建造成額外荷載與剛度改變
description: 違建加蓋特別是頂樓加蓋會增加上方重量、改變建築剛度與週期、或破壞原有結構傳力路徑，使建築耐震能力下降。

source_nodes.reason: 違建加蓋: unauthorized addition (especially rooftop) as a cause of irregular load and stiffness; no canonical equivalent.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 CAUSE_ILLEGAL_ADDITION.

summary: 鋼筋外側混凝土厚度不足以保護鋼筋
description: 保護層為鋼筋外側到構件表面的混凝土厚度，提供鋼筋對抗碳酸化與氯離子侵入的保護。保護層不足將加速鋼筋鏽蝕。

source_nodes.reason: 保護層不足: cause concept (insufficient protective concrete layer). Distinct from AUX_CONCRETE_COVER (the layer itself) which merges to PROP_term_409.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 CAUSE_INSUFFICIENT_COVER.

summary: 混凝土實際抗壓強度低於設計值
description: 混凝土強度不足可由配比錯誤、水灰比過高、加水稀釋、養護不良或時效劣化造成，使構件實際強度與韌性低於設計，整體耐震能力下降。

source_nodes.reason: 混凝土強度不足: cause/phenomenon — actual compressive strength below design value; no canonical equivalent.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 CAUSE_LOW_CONCRETE_STRENGTH.

summary: 建材因環境長期作用降低性能
description: 材料劣化為長期環境作用如溫度循環、濕度變化、紫外線、化學侵蝕造成建材強度與耐久性降低，是老建築表面剝落與裂縫的常見成因。

source_nodes.reason: 材料劣化 (generic material degradation — covers any building material) is broader than CAUSE_CONCRETE_DETERIORATION 混凝土劣化 (specifically concrete).

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: kept_separate_with_link from QA T5 CAUSE_MATERIAL_DEGRADATION; broader_than CAUSE_CONCRETE_DETERIORATION (混凝土劣化).

summary: 依舊版耐震規範設計之建築抗震能力低於現行需求
description: 民國63年以前建築幾乎無耐震規範可循，民國71、78、86、88、94年逐次修訂耐震規範，每次都顯著提高設計地震力與韌性配筋要求。921大地震後規範大幅強化，舊建築相對風險高。

source_nodes.reason: 舊耐震規範不足: building designed under outdated code with weaker requirements; no canonical equivalent.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 CAUSE_OBSOLETE_DESIGN_CODE.

summary: 牆面門窗開口角隅應力集中
description: 牆面開口（門窗）角隅幾何不連續，地震或差異沉陷時易在角隅產生斜向應力集中與裂縫。

source_nodes.reason: 開口應力集中: stress-concentration phenomenon at wall openings (door/window corners). Linked to AUX_OPENING (the geometric feature) and CAUSE_term_585 應力集中 (the broader concept).

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: kept_separate_with_link from QA T5 CAUSE_OPENING_NEAR; occurs_at AUX_OPENING (the opening feature).

summary: 牆面粉刷層因收縮或環境變化產生表面網狀裂縫
description: 牆面粉刷層為非結構表面層，因水泥砂漿乾燥收縮、施工厚度不均、底材差異等容易產生表面網狀裂縫，屬非結構性損傷。

source_nodes.reason: 粉刷層收縮龜裂 (the cracking phenomenon in plaster layer — a cause of surface cracks) is conceptually distinct from AUX_PLASTER_LAYER 粉刷層 (the plaster layer material itself).

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: kept_separate_with_link from QA T5 CAUSE_PLASTERING_LAYER; occurs_in AUX_PLASTER_LAYER (粉刷層).

summary: 施工程序、配比或養護不當造成的品質缺陷
description: 施工品質不良含混凝土配比不當、振搗不足造成蜂窩、養護不良、拆模過早、配筋偏差等。直接削弱結構強度與耐久性。

source_nodes.reason: 施工品質不良 (poor construction quality — the upstream cause) leads to CAUSE_term_989 施工損傷 (construction-induced damage — the downstream phenomenon). Different conceptual layers.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: kept_separate_with_link from QA T5 CAUSE_POOR_CONSTRUCTION; causes CAUSE_term_989 (施工損傷).

summary: 建築平面或立面剛度分布不均勻
description: 剛度分布不均使地震力與變形不平均分配，易在剛度突變處產生集中破壞，是樓梯間、騎樓等位置耐震弱點的根本原因。

source_nodes.reason: 剛度分布不均: stiffness irregularity — generic cause, distinct from CAUSE_term_895 (specifically soft-story).

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 CAUSE_STIFFNESS_IRREGULARITY.

summary: 局部受壓區域因應力集中而破壞
description: 承壓破壞由局部高應力集中造成，常見於支承端或集中載重作用點。

source_nodes.reason: 承壓破壞: bearing/local-compression failure mode; no canonical equivalent.

merge_notes: Phase 2.3: new canonical adopted from QA T5 F_BEARING_FAILURE.
